inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read Saturn in Aries in Your Chart
inline.afterHeadingZh: ## 如何在星盘里识别土星行经白羊
inline.titleEn: Five Steps to Map the Saturn in Aries Transit
inline.titleZh: 五步标记土星行经白羊
inline.altEn: Five-step sequence for mapping the Saturn in Aries transit in your natal chart
inline.altZh: 在本命盘中标记土星行经白羊的五个步骤

items.subEn: Locate the house in your natal chart that Aries rules — that life domain is where Saturn's structural demand concentrates from 2026 to 2028.
items.subZh: 在本命盘里定位白羊所主管的宫位，那片人生领域就是 2026 至 2028 年土星结构性要求最集中的地方。

items.nameEn: Read the House, Not the Headline
items.subEn: If Aries falls on your tenth house, the demand is career and public role; if it falls on your seventh, it is partnership and one-to-one commitment.
items.subZh: 白羊落第十宫，要求的是事业与公共角色；落第七宫，要求的是伴侣关系与一对一的长期投入。

items.nameEn: Check for a Saturn Return Overlap
items.nameZh: 确认是否同时是土星回归
items.subEn: Only people born with natal Saturn in Aries get a Return overlaid on this transit — confirm your natal Saturn sign before assuming one.
items.subZh: 只有出生时土星就落在白羊的人才会同时叠加一次回归，先核对本命土星星座，别想当然。

items.subEn: Saturn's 2025 entry, retreat to Pisces, and 2026 re-entry mean the theme previews, pauses, then resumes — treat the early taste as a rehearsal, not the final exam.
items.subZh: 土星 2025 年进入、退回双鱼、再到 2026 年重新进入，意味着主题会预演、暂停、再续上——把早期那一口当彩排，不是期末考。

items.nameEn: Translate the Pressure into a Build
items.subEn: Saturn's signature question is "what structure is missing here" — name one concrete thing to construct in that house rather than brace for loss.
items.subZh: 土星的标志性问题是「这里缺了什么结构」，给那个宫位点名一件具体要去建造的东西，而不是绷紧了等着失去什么。

inline.altEn: Four common misreadings of the Saturn in Aries transit corrected
inline.altZh: 土星行经白羊四种常见误读及其纠正

items.nameEn: This Transit Is My Saturn Return
items.nameZh: 这段行运就是我的土星回归
items.subEn: It is a Return only if your natal Saturn is in Aries. For everyone else it is an ordinary house transit — demanding, but not the once-in-29-years milestone.
items.subZh: 只有本命土星落在白羊才是回归；对其他所有人来说，这只是一次普通的宫位行运，吃力，但不是 29 年一遇的里程碑。

items.nameEn: Saturn in Aries Means Bad Luck for Aries People
items.nameZh: 土星行经白羊意味着白羊座要倒霉
items.subEn: Sun-sign Aries readers feel the first-house version most directly, but the transit is a structuring pressure on initiative, not a sentence. The same demand reaches every sign.
items.subZh: 太阳白羊最直接感到的是第一宫版本，但这段行运是施加在行动力上的结构性压力，不是一纸判书，同一份要求会通过不同的宫位抵达每一个星座。

items.nameEn: The Whole Period Is One Long Hardship
items.nameZh: 整段时间就是一场漫长的苦熬
items.subEn: The passage moves through retrograde and direct phases with distinct peaks, so the pressure pulses rather than holding flat, with a clear exit near April 2028.
items.subZh: 这段行经走过逆行与顺行的不同阶段，各有清晰高峰，压力是一阵阵搏动的，2028 年 4 月的离境给了这份功课明确的地平线。

items.nameEn: You Read Your Own Transit Differently
items.nameZh: 读自己的行运和读别人的方法不同
items.subEn: The method is identical for anyone — locate the Aries house, read its domain, then ask what structure it lacks. No special-case reading exists for your own chart.
items.subZh: 方法对谁都一模一样——先定位白羊宫、再读它主管的领域、然后问它缺什么结构——并不存在专门留给你自己星盘的特殊读法。
